_doc: Expiring allowlist of KNOWN high/critical PROD-dependency advisories, consumed by scripts/npm-audit-gate.mjs (wired into .github/workflows/security.yml). Mirrors the cargo-audit RUSTSEC_IGNORES discipline in the same workflow. A high/critical in ANY package NOT listed here FAILS the gate. Past `expires`, every entry stops suppressing and the gate re-fails — forcing the dependency-upgrade sprint. Keyed by the top-level npm package name as reported by `npm audit --omit=dev --json`. Each entry is either a reason string (inherits the global `expires`) or `{ reason, expires }` with its OWN expiry — the gate reads the per-entry date first, so a renewal granted for one package cannot keep another one suppressed.
_expiryNote: Re-extended (PROPOSAL, 2026-07-03) 2026-07-31 -> 2026-10-31 for the npm ws/viem wallet debt ONLY. Rationale: the documented exit (wagmi-3, dependabot #181) is UPSTREAM-BLOCKED — @rainbow-me/rainbowkit 2.2.x peers wagmi ^2.9.0 and no RainbowKit release supports wagmi 3 (rainbow-me/rainbowkit discussion #2575, no timeline), so the debt cannot be retired by 2026-07-31. It stays confined to the read-only browser wallet surface (no signer/broadcast/funds). The cargo-audit RUSTSEC allowlist (security.yml ALLOWLIST_EXPIRES) is intentionally LEFT at 2026-07-31 so its fail-honest cliff still forces the operator's per-id re-justification (3 weak ids flagged in #256). The new date + risk-acceptance REQUIRE operator confirmation before merge (proposal PR, no auto-merge). Lockfile-fixed entries (next 15.5.20, hono 4.12.25+, http-proxy-middleware 3.0.7, form-data 4.0.6) remain REMOVED so future highs there block again.

next.reason: Downgrade temporal a Next.js 14.2.28 para compatibilidad React 18 (frontend estabilidad). Sin parche en la línea 14.2.x: `npm audit` marca 23 advisories sobre este árbol (incl. RCE GHSA-p293-qw3h-jr36 y SSRF GHSA-2xp9-vwfh-vxw4) y `fixAvailable` sólo ofrece next 16.4.2, que es major y exige React 19. Salida real: React 18 -> 19 + Next 15/16, bloqueada por el mismo unlock wagmi-3 (#181). Caducidad propia renovada el 2026-10-21: al vencer, el gate vuelve a caer y la migración es la única salida.

allow.axios: Vulnerable copy is axios@1.16.0 EXACT-pinned by nested @coinbase/cdp-sdk (Coinbase CDP wallet SDK) under frontend — same wallet tree already allowlisted above (read-only browser wallet surface, no signer/broadcast/funds). Not directly upgradable without breaking the exact pin; top-level axios-retry accepts 0.x||1.x so a future CDP SDK bump or wagmi-3 upgrade retires it. Plan: resolved with wagmi-3 / @coinbase/cdp-sdk upgrade (dependabot #181). Same shared expiry as the wallet tree.
allow.fast-uri: Transitivo de build-tooling (vite-family, URI parsing). ReDoS-class high; NOT on any runtime request path (build/dev tooling only; the prod gate sees it via the workspace prod-split). Patch available (4.1.2). Plan: retire via dependabot #323 npm-minor-patch group bump; next global expiry cliff (2026-10-31) re-fails if still present.
allow.nanoid: Transitivo (postcss 8 chain, ID generation for CSS builds). Advisory on <3.3.8; harmless in build context (no security-sensitive IDs). Patch available (3.3.18). Plan: retire via dependabot #323 bump; next global expiry cliff (2026-10-31) re-fails if still present.
allow.braces: Transitivo de build-tooling (glob matching, usado por vite/babel/metalsmith). ReDoS-class high en <3.0.3; NO runtime (el prod-split lo ve porque es prod-dep de un devtool compartido). Patch disponible (3.0.3). Plan: dependabot #323 bump o npm override.
allow.http-proxy-middleware: Re-apareció con nueva advisory (vulnerabilidad en <=2.0.9 ReDoS/SSRF-class). Ya estaba en el allowlist histórico y fue REMOVIDO tras lockfile-fix 3.0.7; el advisory nuevo (2026-10) afecta <=3.0.6. Se usa SOLO en dev-local edge proxy, no en producción. Plan: bump a >=3.0.7 lockfile-fijo.
allow.micromatch: Transitivo de build-tooling (glob matching, igual familia que braces). ReDoS-class high en <4.0.8; NO runtime. Patch disponible (4.0.8). Plan: dependabot #323 bump o npm override.

_entryExpiryNote: 2026-10-21: the gate enforced only the single global `expires`, so an entry could carry a death date in prose and still suppress — `next` said "Expires: 2026-08-31" and was 51 days past it while still tracked. `scripts/npm-audit-gate.mjs` now reads a per-entry `expires` (object form) and prints each entry's date and days left plus the next cliff. String entries keep inheriting the global date unchanged.
